text:
incident-bot: PAGED: p99 latency breach on route 'stream/gen' in us-west-2. p99 ~2200ms (SLO 800ms). Paging on-call. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/contbatch-tail

irene: oncall here, ack. watching dashboard now.

sam: looking — p95 ~580ms, p99 ~2200ms, streaming stalls align with upswing in mean batch size. timeline shows spikes starting 2026-03-17T09:01Z.

morgan: logs show repeated KV cache evictions on same pods + batch size jumps to 80-120 for a few seconds. Mixed seqlen workload flagged in query tags.

dmitri: hypothesis: long requests waiting for batch window are delaying short streaming requests (hetero seq mixing). continuous-batching path is aggregating large sequences into long packs.

sre-ops: quick mitigation options (prefer non-disruptive first):
- reduce max_batch_size for stream/gen to 32
- lower continuous_batching.window_ms to 8
- enable scheduler.fair_short_requests = true (fast-path for <=64 tokens)
- if still bad, flip continuous_batching.enabled=false for the streaming route (falls back to streaming runtime)

morgan: we can also add temporary pack-shed rule to drop/route requests >1k tokens for stream/gen to dedicated long-request pool.

irene: doing stepwise plan — 1) apply max_batch_size=32 + window_ms=8 2) monitor p95/p99 for 5m 3) if no improvement, disable contbatch for route and failover to streaming-compat. I'll make changes and post commands.

sam: dashboard snippet: `p95: 580ms -> 420ms after small tests, p99: 2200ms -> 900ms when we forced pack limit on one pod (short test)`. So it is responsive to batch caps.

irene: running this now. command: ```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  https://console.redwood/api/routes/stream/gen/config \
  -d '{"continuous_batching": {"max_batch_size": 32, "window_ms": 8}}'
```

morgan: applied pack-shed rule in policy engine: `if tokens > 1000 -> route: long-req-pool` (non-blocking).

dmitri: also recommending a scheduler preempt threshold so long batches can be broken after 50ms wait: `scheduler.preempt_after_ms=50` — lets short streams get through.

sre-ops: current telemetry after changes: p95 ~370ms, p99 ~780-980ms (varies across pods). We're below 1s p99 but still flirting with SLO. Continued monitoring.

product-oncall: any confirmed customer impact?

sre-ops: one paid customer reported latency spikes and a few streaming timeouts during the 09:00-09:12 window. Impact estimated <0.5% of requests; no data loss. We initiated mitigation at 09:07 and saw improvement by 09:12.

irene: tagging customer-success & support for the affected workspace, will draft a customer note summarizing root cause = hetero seq length mixing on continuous batching + config thresholds tuned too high.

dmitri: follow-ups (to-do):
- ticket: analyze scheduler fairness across seqlen distributions (owner: dmitri)
- infra: add synthetic mixed-seq stress test in canary pipeline (owner: sam)
- product: consider route-level default of max_batch_size=32 for streaming routes unless proven safe (owner: product-oncall)

morgan: logging note: capture per-request token counts in trace for 48h to help tuning.

irene: handing off to morning on-call (morgan) with notes: applied pack cap, window reduced, pack-shed rule, scheduler tweak suggested but not globally applied. Monitor for 2h and escalate if p99 > 1.2s.

morgan: ack handoff. I will keep an eye and escalate to eng-runtime if we see recurrence.

sam: adding a short postmortem stub and will attach timelines + config diffs.

irene: closing page for now as mitigation is effective, will re-open if regressions. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status updated to 'mitigated' at 1768001380.

[reactions: :eyes: by sam, :white_check_mark: by morgan]
